commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Reece James (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but Giorgi Mamardashvili punches the ball away.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90+3' Reece James (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+2' A pass from Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Chelsea as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
89' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

89' Play continues despite the shouts by some Chelsea players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Craig Pawson interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
89' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
88' The referee is firm and issues Joe Gomez (Liverpool) a deserved yellow card.
87' Corner kicks – 5:2. The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 13:15.
86' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is intercepted by Filip Jorgensen.
84' That looked a certain handball by Joao Pedro (Chelsea) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
83' The game is interrupted. Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
79' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
79' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
78' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.
77' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) replaces Cody Gakpo.
77' Arne Slot is forced to make a change. Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Joe Gomez.
76' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt.
75' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) sends a long ball in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comfortably gathers the ball.
74' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared.
74' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
73' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
71' Calum McFarlane is stunned as referee Craig Pawson shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
71' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was!
70' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:5. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.
68' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Here is a change. Rio Ngumoha is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Alexander Isak (Liverpool).
66' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is caught offside once again, but this one was so tight!
65' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
63' Today's match ends for Andrey Santos who will be replaced by Reece James (Chelsea).
62' Filip Jorgensen steps in and intercepts a long pass from Milos Kerkez (Liverpool).
60' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
60' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

59' A sweet pass finds Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top right corner. Filip Jorgensen is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Liverpool have a corner.
59' Andrey Santos (Chelsea) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
58' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) has a goal ruled out for offside!
55' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

54' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Marc Cucurella, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.

53' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Filip Jorgensen makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
52' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) tries to find Ryan Gravenberch, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
51' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. A free kick is awarded to Chelsea.
50' The goal by Chelsea is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
50' The Chelsea players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
49' Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.

48' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
47' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Liverpool.
46' The whistle blows and Craig Pawson starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sprays a pass out to Jeremie Frimpong, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) sends a long ball forward to Jeremie Frimpong, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
43' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
42' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

39' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and denies him with a nice save.
37' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
37' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
35' 1 - 1 Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) curls the ball towards goal after hitting a truly outstanding free kick and it goes in off the left post!
35' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Craig Pawson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Chelsea win a free kick.
32' Andrey Santos (Chelsea) tries to find Marc Cucurella with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
32' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
32' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
31' 3:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
31' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) swings it in and Marc Cucurella gets on the end of it, but Giorgi Mamardashvili shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
29' Some neat passing and movement from Chelsea as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

28' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
27' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) commits a foul and Craig Pawson immediately signals a free kick.
23' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
21' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
20' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) plays a lovely through ball to Joao Pedro, but he can't beat Giorgi Mamardashvili and loses the ball.
18' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) sends a long ball in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comfortably gathers the ball.
16' The possession of the ball – 55:45.
15' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a long cross over to Alexis Mac Allister, but Filip Jorgensen comes forward to gather the ball.
14' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
13' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

11' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
11' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
10' Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) sends a long ball forward to Marc Cucurella, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
8' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Rio Ngumoha slips it to Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.
6' A poor mid-range free-kick by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
4' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) trips an opposition player and Craig Pawson signals a foul. Liverpool win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
3' Half-chance! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
2' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
Chelsea will kick the game off.
